english.title: Attempt arson with intent to endanger life
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) attempted to commit arson in that without lawful excuse attempted to

(A)_[destroy]_
(B)_[damage]_

by fire **(..SPECIFY PROPERTY..)

(C)_[to the value of **(..SPECIFY VALUE..)]_
(D)_[of a value unknown]_

belonging to **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) intending to destroy or damage such property and intending by the said destruction or damage to endanger the life of **(..SPECIFY PERSON..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 1(1) of the Criminal Attempts Act 1981.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
attempted to commit arson in that without lawful excuse
attempted to destroy/damage by fire property belonging to another
with intent to destroy/damage the property and with intent
by that destruction/damage to endanger life

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
This CJS Code and Standard Offence Wording document OBSOLETE from 31/12/11. New version at CJS Code CD71003A and H9613.

(i) The consent of the Director of Public Prosecutions is required where the damage is to a spouse's property (section 30(4) of the Theft Act 1968).
(ii) The property attempted to be damaged or destroyed MAY belong to the defendant(s).
(iii) See the substantive offence at H471.
